trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. There is no shortcut: story, side strands, activities, collectibles and the 100% checklist all feed into it. Early guides put the platinum at roughly 200 hours, so treat it as a long run. Keep cheats off the whole way, as they are reported to disable trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you start the campaign; nothing before it is needed. Just play the story from the beginning.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Story trophies unlock in order, so keep following the main missions. Check progress in-game (Touch Pad, then Progress) if you want to confirm where you stand. Before the chapter ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 spot for Positive Mental Attitude.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Both protagonists become playable in this chapter, which opens up most of the free-roam list, so use the chapter to start activities and collectibles alongside the story instead of leaving them all for the end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep playing the main missions in order; robbery-related trophies start opening up in Chapters 3 and 4, so bank any chances the story hands you instead of rushing past them.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish the chapter's missions in order; by now the stranger strands and side activities should be well under way, so keep clearing them between story beats.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep a manual save from before it: early reports say the game has no mission replay, so a save is your only way back to try a different approach. Finishing it also opens the 100% completion checklist.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks through the story; play the main missions in order and it will come. No side activity is needed for it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission, so it unlocks by playing the campaign; the heist preparation is part of the mission chain, so follow it through.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story mission — follow the main path and it unlocks as the campaign presents it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story mission, unlocked by playing the campaign in order. No extra preparation is named for it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission set at the airport; play the campaign in order and it unlocks. While you are at VCIA, remember Catch Me If You Can can also be attempted there.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission — finish it as the campaign presents it, in order with the other chapter missions.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist appears after the story (Touch Pad, Progress, 100% Completion) and tracks everything it counts, including 15 of the 18 collectible card sets. Finish the story first, then work the checklist area by area; this is the trophy early guides rank hardest, and finishing it leaves almost nothing else standing.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. There are 397 stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida, so you need a little over half of them. Chase the stunt markers on the map as you travel rather than hunting them all at the end, and check the Progress screen for your count.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Open the map and sample one of everything — a race, a round at the range, fishing, bowling, an arcade game and the rest — rather than grinding one activity. The in-game Progress screen shows what you have tried, so use it to find the one type you have missed.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice each range discipline until the gold time or score feels comfortable, then clear the challenges one by one; gold in every challenge is the whole requirement, so there is no partial credit to chase. Replaying a challenge costs nothing but time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line before racing for the win, and clear locations as you pass them so the last few are not a separate road trip. A win at each location is what counts, not a win count.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter a spread of race types across the map and count distinct events, not repeat wins on the same one — winning the same race twice still leaves you one short. Work through the race list event by event.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, learn the timing it asks for, and keep at it until you outscore him; it is a one-opponent contest, not a grind, so a few focused attempts beat hours of random fishing.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to its end; any single completed game counts, so choose the cabinet you find easiest.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the stranger mission chains: keep returning to his missions whenever they appear until his last one is done. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so do not expect them all in one chapter.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand mission by mission until the finale unlocks; stranger missions appear around the map as you explore, so check back whenever a new marker shows up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission, taking each instalment as it appears on the map.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear around the map as you explore; take each one when you find it and follow its chain to the end. Eight finished strands is the count — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so three more strands are waiting out in the state.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand through to its last mission, returning whenever a new instalment appears.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand through to its last mission, as with the other stranger chains.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy early guides flag as possibly missable: one meditation spot (Lucia's balcony) is reported to belong to Chapter 1 only, and the game reportedly has no mission replay. Meditate at every spot you pass, keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, and do the Chapter 1 spot before that chapter ends.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt targets one specific animal; track it with the hunting tools the game gives you and take the shot when it presents itself. It is a single hunt, not a quota of kills.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game; finish any 3 by finding every card in each set. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you travel and keep sets together rather than grabbing cards at random.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The counter is the thing: open the WAiNK It feature at 100 different spots as you move around the state, and the trophy pops at the hundredth. Fold it into ordinary travel instead of making it a separate grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks in the Progress screen; clear 50 of them across activities, driving, combat and exploration rather than forcing one category. They accumulate naturally if you vary what you do.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Pick a quiet stretch of road, draw the heat together, then break line of sight and stay out of the search until the stars clear. Do it when a partner moment comes up — it needs the two of you together, so do not leave it for a solo session.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, hit them in quick succession, and keep moving between them so the heat never drops. A getaway car parked close to the third shop makes the escape much easier.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive anything new you see — the game logs each model the first time you get in it — so vary your rides instead of sticking to one car. Car parks, traffic and dealerships are all fair game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of five, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them before the effect ends; a quiet approach first keeps the group together instead of scattering it. If the group breaks up, let the effect end and try again.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Get airside and leave in something that was not scheduled to fly — a grabbed plane, not a ticket. Do it when the chance appears; airport security will notice, so have your exit planned before you board.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Find a Rhino in free roam or during a wanted rampage and get the better of it with heavy weapons, or take it for yourself if you can. The name is a joke about hot armour; the job is simply to beat a tank at its own game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm; if you are spotted, back out and try again rather than fighting through it, since a clean run is the whole requirement.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Plan each vault job — entry, the vault itself, and a clean getaway route — and count five completed escapes. Vaults are the big jobs of this list, so treat each one as its own operation rather than a smash-and-grab.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and break away before the response arrives. A blocking vehicle and a fast car waiting nearby turn a messy robbery into a clean one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail into every named area until the map is filled in; the Progress screen tracks what is left, so use it to find the corners you have never visited rather than re-driving the same roads.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang, hit it and get clear; nine gangs means nine separate jobs, so work the list gang by gang and mark each one off as you go.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot with a view over Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take it in — a quiet moment, not a mission. Any venue on the beachfront with a view should do.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, drive a car through its front and out the other side — build speed on the approach and keep going once you are through the glass. Treat it as a set piece: do it when you see a showroom, since it is a one-moment stunt, not a repeatable activity.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, start a game and follow it through to the last frame — follow-through is the point of the description, so finish the game rather than walking out halfway.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it points to a story moment with your partner, not to a named activity. Play the story and it should unlock at the right beat; no separate step is named, so treat it as a watch-for-it moment during the campaign rather than a free-roam task.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This tracks the choices you make through the story — PSN counts them toward 500 — so play the campaign and make decisions as they come. There is no single mission to replay for it; it accumulates across the whole story, so keep playing and deciding.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name says it: succeed on a second attempt at something that beat you the first time. If a story moment or activity goes wrong once, go straight back and clear it — the trophy is about the retry, not the first try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No confirmed unlock method exists yet at launch — it reads as an easter-egg or strange-encounter trophy. Explore odd corners of Leonida and keep an eye on early guides; do not chase a specific spot until one is confirmed, because any spot named today would be a guess.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. While driving past on a bike or in a car, swing a melee weapon and knock someone down — a drive-by without firing a shot. Line the pass up first, then swing as you go by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the counter climbs toward $250,000. Keep robbing and laundering rather than spending dirty cash, and the total adds up across the whole run.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy cars, clothes, weapons and upgrades until the total passes $100,000; big purchases count fastest, so save the shopping spree for after the story pays out, when money is no longer tight.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the market — they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for the Scooter Bros app, so buy them before you start collecting cars in earnest.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 different vehicles, bring them into the app and register each one; stolen, bought and found rides all count once they are in. Pair it with Little Boxes so you have garages to keep them in.
